title: Seminar in Cybersecurity; Interpersonal Cyber Communications
description:
Restrictions: Must be a student in the ACES (Advanced Cybersecurity Experience for Students) Living-Learning Program

Master the art of translating cybersecurity concepts into clear, compelling messages that resonate. This course provides students with anintroduction to professional and technical communication skills withinthe cybersecurity field in the age of artificial intelligence (AI). Through hands-on projects and real-world scenarios, you'll learn to write and share cyber communications for audiences from technical teams to executives. Exploring AI large language models (LLMs) to enhance efficiency while ensuring critical human judgment will prepare you for the metamorphosis occurring in the cyber field. Connecting directly withindustry professionals through guest speaker sessions, you will gainan insider perspective on the communication challenges they face daily. This coursebridges the gap between technical expertise and professional influence to help you develop the versatile communication toolkit that sets apart exceptional professionals.
